reason: Prioritize vdown4-rest3-g128: it targets the projections already protected by the default mixed pattern while extending protection to all value/down projections, with most weights still at 3 bits. This is an unmeasured hypothesis for recovering the observed quality loss of 3-bit and sparse mixed recipes at lower memory than int4. Second, mixed3-4-g64 tests whether finer groups improve the measured mixed 3/4 recipe’s quality while retaining its selective protection. The evidence does not establish either candidate will meet both gates: no heldout tasks or BF16 throughput reference were supplied. The 0.0 quality result for mixed2-4 also argues against prioritizing aggressive 2-bit recipes.
